-- Testar se a comparação direta (como o Drizzle faz) é case-sensitive no banco
SELECT 
  email,
  email = 'limiransafg@gmail.com' AS match_minusculo,
  email = 'Limiransafg@gmail.com' AS match_maiusculo,
  BINARY email = 'limiransafg@gmail.com' AS binary_match_minusculo
FROM allowed_clients
WHERE id = 2850001;
